items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Sammy Williams and Joy John always playing together at that time.

ctx.x: Was that the regular Sam Morgan band or the Isaiah Morgan? Which group did you play with?
Well, Sam Morgan, he had his own band. And after he got paralyzed, his brother Isaiah Morgan, he took the band over. He played in his speech. Yeah. But one time, Isaiah Morgan, he was a band.

his own band. That's what I heard. Yeah he had his own band one time. Just like me I had my own band one time. It was a name after me, Kit Stevenson. Oh yeah, Kit Stevenson. Yeah that's the time I was telling you about I and Sammy, Sammy Williams and Joy John always playing together at that time. Now you mentioned once was it Chris Kelly that taught me. That taught you down in the, that was on the plantation? No he taught me right here in New Orleans. He taught me in New Orleans. I wanted to go all the way back…
